data.gender_notes: Jagdis is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jagat (world) + Dis (conqueror) = Jagdis. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is rooted in Hindu mythology. Jagdis is a powerful name, signifying one who has the strength and courage to conquer all aspects of life. The name Jagdis carries the meaning “Conqueror of the World” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagdis usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
